title: Ben Johnson: Luther Burden competes like Amon-Ra St. Brown, wants to be the best

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Ben Johnson: Luther Burden competes like Amon-Ra St. Brown, wants to be the best
sources.description: Bears coach Ben Johnson says wide receiver Luther Burden is poised to build off his promising rookie season in 2025 and become one of the best receivers in the NFL.
